subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or adopt the open conflicting fork PR before allowing a narrow replacement fix for this Telegram approval cleanup bug?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and the fix shape is clear, but GitHub still links an open closing PR that is conflicting and points at the obsolete handler path, so automation should not create a competing fix without a maintainer choosing the branch strategy.

options.title: Close the conflicting fork PR and queue a replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR, then allow a narrow OpenClaw PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR manually
options.body: A maintainer can preserve contributor credit by rebuilding the useful idea from the fork branch onto the active runtime path.

options.title: Keep waiting on the linked PR
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the fork PR, accepting that the current linked branch is conflicting and does not target the current implementation path.

recommendation.title: Close the conflicting fork PR and queue a replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR, then allow a narrow OpenClaw PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person appears in recent current-file and adjacent approval SDK history, making them the best available routing candidate for the branch strategy choice.
